popCulture.title: Odyssey
popCulture.creator: Homer
popCulture.description: Homer makes Periboea youngest daughter of mighty Eurymedon, mate of Poseidon, and mother of Nausithous — the mortal stem of the Phaeacian kings of Scheria.

popCulture.title: Nausithous
popCulture.description: Periboea's son by Poseidon — the godlike founder who leads the Phaeacians from Hypereia to Scheria.

popCulture.title: Poseidon
popCulture.description: Periboea's lover — the earth-shaker whose son Nausithous founds the island people who will later ferry Odysseus home.

popCulture.title: Periboea
popCulture.description: Daughter of Eurymedon — carefully distinct from the Corinthian, Calydonian, and Spartan naiad Periboeas.
